template.name: Mindray PiCCO Module – AS/NZS 3551 PVT
template.desc: PiCCO (CCO and IBP) module, CF applied part. From the CHS Ansur template “PiCCO Module AS-NZS 3551 PVT”. Needs the ESA612.

steps.title: Visual inspection
steps.instructions: Inspect the module, its cables and its connectors. Do not open the module.

items: The case, display screen, buttons, power cord, and accessories have no obvious signs of damage.
The external connecting cables are not frayed and the connector pins are not loose or bent.
The external connectors are not loose and their pins are not bent.
The safety labels and data plate are clearly legible.
The power-on test is passed. The power indicator and alarm system works correctly and the monitor starts up properly.

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions: Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply you are testing from.

steps.title: Protective earth resistance
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet. Clip the red test lead to an exposed earthed metal part, such as a rear-panel screw.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test.

steps.title: Insulation: applied parts to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test. Recorded only. The Ansur template sets no limit for this measurement.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to applied parts
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test. Must be over 1 Mohm (AS/NZS 3551 B9.3). The Ansur template set no limit for this measurement.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to non-earth accessible conductive part
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test.

steps.title: Insulation: applied parts to non-earth accessible conductive part
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test. Recorded only. The Ansur template sets no limit for this measurement.

steps.title: Enclosure leakage
steps.instructions:
Connect the test lead a conductive non-earthed exposed part on the DUT.
Note: Only a representative sample of conductive non-earthed exposed parts need to be tested.

steps.title: Earth leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet. The device will be switched on and off between conditions. Limits: 5000 µA normal, 10000 µA neutral open (AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2 B11.6).

steps.title: Patient leakage
steps.instructions: Connect each applied part (patient cable, sensor) to its ESA612 posts. Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet.

steps.title: Mains on applied parts
steps.instructions: Connect each applied part (patient cable, sensor) to its ESA612 posts. Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet.

steps.title: PiCCO Performance Tests
steps.instructions:
IBP Performance Test:
1. Connect the patient simulator, the PiCCO IBP test cable, and the PiCCO module.
2. Set the patient simulator to output 0 mmHg to the pArt channel and the pCVP channel.
3. In the pArt Setup menu, select pArt Zero >>→Zero.
4. In the pCVP Setup menu, select pCVPZero >>→Zero.
5. Set the patient simulator to output static pressure 200 mmHg to the pArt channel and 20 mmHg to the pCVP channel.
6. Check that the pArt value displayed on the monitor is within 200±4 mmHg, and pCVP value within 20±1 mmHg.

IBP Performance Test:
1. Set the patient simulator to output ART signal to the pArt channel and CVP signal to the pCVP channel. Check whether the IBP waveform is correctly displayed.

IBP Pressure Calibration:
1. Connect the patient simulator, the PiCCO IBP test cable, and the PiCCO module.
2. Set the patient simulator to output 0 mmHg to the pArt channel and the pCVP channel.
3. In the pArt Setup menu, select pArt Zero >>→Zero.
4. In the pCVP Setup menu, select pCVPZero >>→Zero.
5. Set static pressure to 200 mmHg on the patient simulator.
6. Select Main Menu→Maintenance >>→User Maintenance >>→ enter the password →Cal. IBP Press. >>. In the Cal. IBP Press.menu, set the calibration pressure to 200 mmHg.
7. In the Cal. IBP Press.menu, select the Calibrate button next to the target IBP channel to start calibration. If the calibration succeeds, the message "Calibration Completed!" is displayed. If the calibration fails, a corresponding message is displayed.

C.O Test:
1. Connect the PiCCO C.O. test cable, PiCCO module, the patient simulator, and C.O. adapter box.
2. Set the blood temperature (TB) to 37°C on the patient simulator and check that the temperature displayed on the monitor is within 37±0.1°C.
3. In the CCO Setup menu, select PiCCO Guide >>, and check if the value of Catheter Type is PV2015L20.
4. Turn the injectate temperature (TI) knob on the C.O. adapter box to set the TI to 20±1°C for the patient simulator (31 on the converter box) and C.O. to 5 L/min. Set Injectate temp to 24°C on the simulator.
5. In the PiCCO screen, start the C.O. measurement. As soon as the prompt [Inject XXml] is displayed, adjust TI to 4±1°C (61 on the converter box), and then quickly back to 20±1°C (31 on the converter box), then press the Start button on the simulator. The whole procedure should be finished within 10s.
6. Verify the C.O. value is displayed on the monitor.

items: IBP Performance Test: pArt is displayed correctly
IBP Performance Test: pCVP is displayed correctly
IBP Pressure Calibration: Calibration is successful
C.O Test: C.O. Value is displayed on the monitor and no errors are shown.

readings.label: IBP Performance Test: pArt is within 200 ±4
IBP Performance Test: pCVP is within 20 ±1
